events.text:
Thank you, Grace. Your identity is verified.

I found the charge. It's order **O-5109** from Burger Barn, placed October 23 at 1:10 PM Pacific, for $28.10. Because you say you didn't place this order, I've escalated it to a human specialist (reference ESC-700). A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I haven't issued any refund or credit, since the specialist needs to review the charge first.

I can't confirm whether your account was accessed. The specialist will look into that as part of the review. In the meantime, I'd suggest:

- **Change your Forkful password** and turn on two-factor authentication if the app offers it.
- **Check your email account** for any unexpected sign-in or password reset messages.
- **Contact your card issuer** to report the charge. They can block the card or issue a new one if needed.

Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, so it's escalated and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours. Can't you just refund the $28.10 now, though? I'd really rather not wait a day for my own money back.

I understand you want your money back quickly, but I can't refund the charge myself. When a customer reports a charge they didn't make, our policy requires a specialist to review it first, and that's why I escalated it. The specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

While you wait, you can also contact your card issuer and report the $28.10 charge from Forkful on October 23. They can start a dispute and may be able to help you get the money back faster. If you do that, mention the Forkful reference ESC-700.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

Okay, I'll wait for the specialist, but I'm not thrilled about it. I'm going to change my password and call my bank today.

Can you tell me one more thing? The order was Burger Barn, but I've never ordered from them. Where was it supposed to be delivered? If it was somewhere I've never been, that would make this a lot more worrying.

Here are the details for order O-5109:

- **Delivered to:** 400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA 94950
- **Your address on file:** 15 Orchard St, Oakdale, CA 94609. The order did not go to this address.
- **Items:** Double smash burger ($15.50) and onion rings ($6.00)
- **Payment:** Visa ending in 4242
- **Timeline:** Placed 1:10 PM, picked up 1:31 PM, delivered 1:47 PM on October 23

Since you've never been to that address and didn't place the order, please tell the specialist and your bank about the Riverton address. Your bank may also want to know the card ending in 4242 may have been used without your permission.

Please also make sure your Forkful password is changed and check for any saved addresses or payment methods on your account that you don't recognize.

Riverton? I have never had anything delivered there, and I've never been to that address. My address is Oakdale. This is really worrying now. Someone must have set up an order using my card and sent it somewhere else.

Okay, I'll tell the specialist and my bank about Riverton. I'm changing my password right now and I'll check for any addresses or cards on the account I don't recognize. I'll wait for the follow-up.
